summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.
- FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix Canadian province tax calculation for Quebec (QST) in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Search optimization and Kafka repartition migration are paused/superseded for now.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours: caused stuck jobs to remain invisible for hours.
- Per-invoice embedding calls: 5,000-document rebuild took 8.42 seconds.

## Recent work
Search rebuilds were optimized with tenant scoping, shared bounded embedding, bulk vector upserts, and a unique tenant/document index; full suite passed 247 tests, and 10,000-document median improved from 16.73s to 2.41s. CSV output was fixed to use explicit UTF-8, with eight exporter tests passing. Now focus on Quebec tax calculations.
